Name: Fish Spot Bait
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod lets you set an item (default: [b]Bait[/b]) that can be dropped into the water to set the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Fishing#Bubbles]fish bubbles[/url] location to somewhere near that spot.

You can change the item in the config, using either the item's name or index.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
